title: Launch review: beta sequence
notes:
Decisions:
- Beta goes to Northwind and Kestrel first, by allowlist. Lumen waits for its countersigned DPA.
- Beta caps date ranges at 30 days (ATLAS-40).
- Security: no objection to flag-gated beta. GA still needs ATLAS-41 and ATLAS-50.
- General availability is decided only after the Nov 10 SSO verification.
Open: Azure AD clock skew (ATLAS-44) must land before Nov 10.
Recorded principle (owner-confirmed): internal or design-partner beta may ship before enterprise SSO if the rollout is reversible. GA may not.

title: Incident review: INC-2291 and INC-2294
notes: Reviewed the DST duplicate incident and the staging lock. Action items: postmortem Monday Nov 9 (Wei). Add concurrent-index CI check (done, #222). Confirm billing recompute (done, BILL-209).

title: Design partner check-in: Northwind, Kestrel, Lumen
notes: Northwind and Kestrel: ready, agreements signed. Lumen: DPA countersignature expected Monday. All three accepted beta limits: no enterprise SSO, 30-day ranges, reversible rollout. Ops leads want to see who has access right now (allowlist table).

title: Q4 planning: Atlas headcount
notes: Two backend hires and one SRE approved, contingent on GA forecast. Forecast assumes GA by Dec 15 with Halvorsen signed; a slip to Q1 moves about $60k out of Q4 recognized revenue.

title: Design partner interview synthesis
notes: Six interviews. Top needs: know who has access, pause a rollout instantly, see raw events behind numbers. Allowlist and kill switch are in the design.
